description: Bogazici University maintains ELER, developed through the NERIES project, for earthquake shaking and loss estimation in the Euro-Mediterranean region. Its modules estimate shaking and then building damage, casualties or economic losses from available population and building inventories, with a pipeline-damage module also described. The provider states that the method is updated regularly and links a basic version and technical guide. Published by Boğaziçi University, Kandilli Observatory and Earthquake Research Institute.
